children: His new role covers working capital, cost management, risk management and governance at the Jharsuguda unit
Vedanta Aluminium Metal has appointed Abhinav Gupta as Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Jharsuguda, effective July 2026.
Gupta joins from Vedanta Sesa Goa Iron Ore, where he served as Deputy CFO – Iron Ore Business from December 2021 to June 2026.

In his new role, Gupta will oversee financial strategy, business planning, cash flow, working capital, capital allocation, cost management, risk management, compliance and governance for the Jharsuguda unit.

Before joining Vedanta Sesa Goa, Gupta spent nearly 16 years at Hindustan Zinc in finance roles. He served as Head Finance, RA SBU from July 2019 to December 2021 and Head Finance, Project Vertical from August 2014 to June 2019.
Earlier, he was Head Finance, DSC SBU at Hindustan Zinc from January 2011 to July 2014 and Head Finance, Zinc Smelter, Debari, Udaipur, from March 2006 to January 2011.
Gupta is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds a Bachelor of Commerce in Accounting and Finance from Maheshwari Higher Secondary, Jaipur.
